verify.note: Closed 2026-09-30 (ADR-1676). Measures the consequence on the pure gate itself: it imports lib/personas-core.ts and requires personaActivationVerdict to allow Practitioner and Organization with a charges-enabled account (binding that account id), to refuse them for no account, an unfinished account, a null read and charges without an id (with a refusal that names the payout account and Billing), and never to gate Collaborator or Business; CONNECT_WIRED is no longer exported and PERSONA_PAYOUT_HREF points at /settings/billing. Then, in order, the staff action reads getConnectStatus(profileId), asks the verdict, binds patch.stripe_account_id, and only then writes the row; the Activate button is gated on canActivate; /partners/join renders PayoutPromptCard for a verified money persona awaiting its account and links PERSONA_PAYOUT_HREF; and no persona or Connect file still calls the binding a stub. Fails on main (f7f7d3075) at the first arm. Runs in about 0.1 s CPU, no spawn.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1676). PREMISE HELD at f7f7d3075 (main): lib/personas.ts and lib/personas-core.ts still called the binding stubbed, CONNECT_WIRED was a false constant that refused every verified to active move for every program, and nothing read a Connect account on that path, though the member Connect account (profiles.stripe_account_id, stripe_charges_enabled) and profile_personas.stripe_account_id both already existed. WHAT CHANGED. A pure gate, personaActivationVerdict in lib/personas-core.ts: a money persona (Practitioner, Organization) goes Active only when its member's one Connect account has an id and charges enabled, and the verdict carries that id; Collaborator and Business take no money and the ladder alone decides them. The staff action (app/(main)/admin/personas/actions.ts) reads getConnectStatus fresh, refuses with a sentence naming the payout account and Billing, and on success writes profile_personas.stripe_account_id with the state. /admin/personas shows No payout account yet, Payout account ready or Payout bound, offers Activate only when the gate passes, and counts the verified programs waiting on an account. /partners/join tells a verified Practitioner or Organization it goes Active once they have a payout account, links /settings/billing#payouts, and renders the shared PayoutPromptCard (which starts onboarding inline). CONNECT_WIRED and awaitingConnect are gone; the stub comments are rewritten. Sell paths are unchanged: every one already checks Connect at checkout. No new Stripe account system and no migration: the per-persona column existed since 20260608060001. Tests: lib/personas.test.ts and app/(main)/admin/personas/actions.test.ts (charges enabled activates and binds; no account, an unfinished account, or a jump from claimed is refused and writes nothing).
